info.title: Massara
info.synopsis: La trama di Massara è ispirata alla canzone omonima di Kiyoe Yoshioka, cantante degli Ikimono-gakari, ed è il suo primo singolo da solista. Questo cortometraggio anime, diretto da Keita Nagahara e animato dallo studio ENISHIYA Inc., racconta la storia di Nazuna, una cantautrice che sta per abbandonare il suo sogno, e di Yuna, una ragazza molto timida. Le due si incontrano e, grazie alla loro influenza reciproca, trovano la forza per creare il proprio futuro. Sintesi: Massara è un cortometraggio che segue l'incontro tra una cantautrice disillusa e una ragazza timida, che si aiutano a vicenda a realizzare i propri sogni.

info.title: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World
info.synopsis: Togo Asagaki è il Red Ranger di un gruppo super sentai che viene sconfitto da un'organizzazione malvagia durante il loro scontro finale. Ormai rassegnato alla morte, si ritrova trasportato in un mondo completamente diverso! Abbracciando il suo nuovo ruolo di avventuriero, si trasforma in Kizuna Red e continua la sua ricerca della giustizia mentre aiuta i bisognosi. Ben presto incontra la giovane maga Idola ed assieme a lei inizierà il viaggio che lo porterà a diventare il protettore di questo nuovo mondo.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Yihdra is the brilliant child of a disgraced court mage, who seeks to redeem her family's reputation and use sorcery for good. But when she meets an adventurer who transforms into an all-red suit wielding otherworldly weapons, it could be the first step in achieving her dream... or it could drive her crazy!

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Yihdra has become an adventurer to learn more about Togo and his powers, but after an adventuring duo earns her hatred with some rude remarks about her father, it escalates into a race to see who can clear a dungeon first.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Teltina, is the third princess of the kingdom of Avallost, joined by her Hero, Lowji. She is on a crusade to combat a threat to the people, and eager to recruit Yihdra and Togo, but her knight in shining armor isn't quite as enthusiastic...

episodes.title: Episodio 12

info.title: Nausicaä della Valle del Vento
info.synopsis: La terra, devastata da un olocausto nucleare, è un deserto arido e inospitale dominato da una giungla tossica esalante venefici miasmi in continua espansione. La civiltà degli uomini, regredita a uno stadio medievale, occupa sparute oasi di natura fertile, fra cui la Valle del vento, un piccolo e pacifico regno guidato dalla giovane principessa Nausicaä. Questa, convinta protettrice di ogni forma di vita e caparbia ricercatrice, è molto vicina a trovare una soluzione per "guarire" la foresta fungina e di conseguenza l'intero ecosistema. Ma il suo regno rimarrà intrappolato nello scacchiere di due grandi potenze belligeranti sconsideratamente pronte a scatenare un'altra catastrofe, e Nausicaä dovrà fare appello a tutto il suo coraggio e alla sua forza d'animo quando il destino del suo popolo si compirà con l'avverarsi di un'antica profezia.

info.title: Guilty Gear Strive: Dual Rulers
info.synopsis: Dopo il declino di scienza e tecnologia, una nuova fonte energetica nota come "magia" alimenta l'epoca moderna. L'umanità arriva così a creare delle armi biologiche proibite, i Gears, che a un certo punto si ribellano. Il genere umano sopravvive al conflitto, ma con perdite enormi, con ferite anche emotive che nemmeno con i decenni trascorsi si sono completamente rimarginate. In questo contesto, Sin Kiske, figlio di un umano e di un Gear, si reca al matrimonio dei suoi genitori, considerabile per certi versi come un'eresia, e infatti persino in un mondo oramai in pace sono serviti molti anni per poter celebrare le nozze. All'improvviso, appare una misteriosa ragazza, che detesta i Gears... l'incontro tra il figlio di una simile unione e la ragazza sconvolgerà il mondo.

info.title: Renkin San-kyuu Magical? Pokaan
info.synopsis: La serie narra le bizzarre avventure di quattro ragazze molto particolari: Yūma la strega, Pachira il vampiro, Liru il licantropo e Aiko l'androide. Principesse di un altro mondo, decidono di avventurarsi in quello degli umani finendo per abitare in una casetta abbarbicata su un grande albero. La loro vita sarà un constante susseguirsi di situazioni comuni e non, una più divertente dell'altra.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis:
A. Super Doctor K-Ko and Hongo have devised traps that end up trapping Pachira, Liru, and Aiko. Thus, Uma ends up coming to the rescue.

B. Upon learning about mail, Uma tries to build a mailbox with Aiko's help so that the girls can receive mail. Then the next part involves trying to get the mailman on their route to give them mail.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis:
A. Following an incident at the prehistoric mammal section of the museum, Liru discovers love when she meets a man named Ryo who turns out to be another werewolf.

B. While watching TV, Uma and Pachira learn about home shopping when they see an Electric Trainer (a type of fitness belt) on TV. When Uma orders for the Electric Trainer, the other girls get interested in TV shopping until they learn that home shopping includes having to pay for the stuff.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis:
A. When encountering a cute guy outside of a Blood Donation Bus, Pachira ends up donating some of her blood and ends up weak. This ends up tempting her to try to suck blood from Uma and Liru.

B. While in a movie theater, the girls discuss their dream boyfriend. When Aiko's weight ends up disabling an elevator, the girls talk about how they would meet their dream boyfriend while stripping into their underclothes when the elevator gets warmer.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis:
A. During the rainy season, Aiko's systems are covered in mildew making her voice sound bad. While Liru is playing in the rain, Uma and Pachira try to clean Aiko's systems upon deactivating her.

B. A heat wave has struck Hikarigaoka and the girls learn that Tanabata occurs on the 7th of July while deciding what wish should be granted by it.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis:
A. When a typhoon ruins their day at the beach, the girls try to improvise at the nearest hotel.

B. Following an accident with their floats, the girls are saved from drowning by Lulu, a mermaid who is the princess of the merfolk. They soon help her in obtaining a boy that she has a crush on, who Yuma ends up take. Lulu finds a mate in a jellyfish and, at the end of the episode, Yuma and the other nether princess have a fight. The girls (excluding Yuma)go home, while Yuma and the boy go for a swim, the boy turns out to be a spirit leading Yuma to her doom.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis:
A. In a follow-up to the ending of the previous episode, Uma has died and is condemned to Hell by Enma (played by Super Doctor K-Ko). In each level of Hell, Uma encounters hellish and demonic counterparts of her fellow princesses where she ends up driving them crazy.

B. With help from Jun, Tan, and Liru's werewolf form, Uma performs magic tricks in the park to entertain the people there and show off her magic.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis:
A. Liru prepares for the viewing of the Full Moon by obtaining the supplies to it and finding a perfect spot in the park to view the Full Moon at.

B. In this Super Robot-type segment, Uma, Pachira, Liru, and Keimie act out as Magical 5 to save their teammate Aiko and their fuel company from a giant Mecha-Hongo robot created by Super Doctor K-Ko.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis:
A. People throughout Hikarigaoka are being attacked by a vampire at night. Jun, Tan, and Liru each suspect Pachira for the attacks upon seeing her silhouette attack someone. Pachira suspects that someone else is behind these attacks.

B. Aiko wins Happy Chalk from a prize in Makai Teen Magazine which can bring anything that's drawn to life. Since it can only work for a witch, Uma uses it to draw various things including drawing up a galactic train to take them to the Andromeda Galaxy in one of Aiko's attempts to gain a human body.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis:
A. While out getting Ishiyakiimo (yams baked on hot stones), Liru ends up saving a guy from being beaten up. She then ends up seeing a fallen CD with its shape turning her into her werewolf form. When Aiko invites him to their house, Liru doesn't want to be seen in her current form and Pachira wants him to herself.

B. After reading a Christmas story, the girls prepare for Christmas ranging from Aiko making a metal stocking, the girls preparing a Christmas feast, the girls solving their chimney problem, and the girls preparing for the arrival of Santa Claus.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis:
A. The girls hit the slopes and learn how to ski. When they fail to make a reservation at one of the lodges, they end up staying with some snow people who attempt to add them to their frozen collection.

B. While walking through the woods, the girls find a hot spring that Liru told them about and end up encountering women who turn out to be Tanukis that end up stealing their clothes.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis:
A. The girls play a "speaking English" game hosted by Keimie and a mess-up has them drinking the bad-tasting Natto drink.

B. The girls see Super Doctor K-Ko on a TV show revolving on the theory of horror movie monsters existing amongst the human race. When the co-host of the TV show ends up discovering the girl's secret thanks to footage used by Super Doctor K-Ko, it is then made public. The girls experience fame up to the point where they end up on a discussion show against Super Doctor K-Ko in the discussion if monsters from the Netherworld are dangerous.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis:
A. Aiko finds a VCR that contains her memories as a rerun of the girls' favorite show is airing. When the girls plan to use the VCR to tape it, they end up needing D/A Converter to hook it up to their Digital Television and search the entire country for one.

B. When Uma ends up with a cold, she ends up getting the other girls infected with her magic when they make fun of her. With her magic perfected, she practices it on the town. After curing herself and the other girls of the cold, they soon work on a way to make a Cherry Blossom Tree in front of a hospital bloom early when Uma runs out of magic.

info.synopsis: Seconda stagione di Call of the Night

episodes.title: Prima notte - Quello non è un tempo per noi
episodes.synopsis: Le amiche di Nazuna decidono di prendere Ko per divertirsi alle sue spalle per una sera e, forse, aiutarlo a innamorarsi della vampira. Hatsuka, tuttavia, ha più interesse a parlare con Nazuna di ciò che c’è tra lei e quel giovane.

episodes.title: Seconda notte - Volevo proprio incontrarti
episodes.synopsis: Mahiru sta vivendo un momento di contrasto con Ko, e ne parla con la donna misteriosa che incontra la notte, Kiku. L’onesto desiderio di rappacificarsi porterà a una serie di incontri sorprendenti e più pericolosi di quanto chiunque avrebbe mai potuto immaginare.

episodes.title: Terza notte - Tutti sanno che nella casa stregata non ci sono i fantasmi
episodes.synopsis: L’incontro con la detective Anko ha serie conseguenze e mette in stato d’allarme tutta la comunità di vampiri. Nazuna stessa non potrà più fare finta di nulla e, grazie anche alla spinta di Ko, inizierà a indagare sul proprio passato.

episodes.title: Quarta notte - Vuoi diventare capace di correre?
episodes.synopsis: Kabura permette a Ko e Nazuna di esplorare l’ospedale di notte, ma non sembra disposta a parlare troppo facilmente di ciò che sa. C’è un legame tra lei e Nazuna, ma la sua natura è avvolta nel mistero. Comprenderlo sarà essenziale per iniziare a risolvere l’enigma del passato di Nazuna.

episodes.title: Quinta notte – Gli anni che ho trascorso con te
episodes.synopsis: Kabura parla della sua storia e di come questa si intreccia con le origini di Nazuna. Parte del loro passato viene finalmente alla luce, e questo cambierà molto la prospettiva che Nazuna e Ko hanno su ciò che sta accadendo.

episodes.title: Sesta notte – Non era la qualità a preoccuparmi
episodes.synopsis: Nazuna e Ko accompagnano Midori a incontrare una persona inaspettata. L’intenzione è scoprire di più sul passato della vampira per eliminare i suoi punti deboli, e nessuno è più adatto ad aiutarli della sua misteriosa conoscenza.

episodes.title: Settima notte – Tu sei scema, Nanakusa
episodes.synopsis: When Ko finds the diary of a girl called Kyoko, he discovers that he wasn't Nazuna's first human friend. Nor the first person she ever considered turning...

episodes.title: Ottava notte – Sei la prima con cui voglio farlo, senpai
episodes.synopsis: What began as Kyoko and Nazuna's investigation into a supposed affair led to a life-changing event that altered their relationship forever.

episodes.title: Nona notte – Tu cosa hai intenzione di fare, Yamori?
episodes.synopsis: Vampires cannot be harmed by conventional means, so what does Anko hope to accomplish by shooting them out in the open? Ko suspects there’s a method to her madness.

episodes.title: Decima notte – Volevo almeno che lo facessi tu
episodes.synopsis: As the battle between vampire and hunter erupts, Ko finally realizes the full scope of what's at stake. Now he must stop both Anko and Nazuna before it's too late.

episodes.title: Undicesima notte – Pciù
episodes.synopsis: Something's wrong. Or maybe too right. Ko isn't a vampire, so why does it feel like his body's ignoring the rules? He and Nazuna need answers.

episodes.title: Dodicesima notte – Il richiamo della notte
episodes.synopsis: Growing up doesn't guarantee answers to life. As Ko wonders what it means to be ordinary, he and Nazuna venture through the city. Where will the night take them this time?

Quando un misterioso gatto di nome Pallas appare nel loro bagno, li trasforma nei Haikara Romantic Group, un gruppo di “Battle Lovers” con poteri magici grazie a speciali braccialetti. Ora devono affrontare il Bankara New Elite Corps, un gruppo di studenti del consiglio scolastico che punta a imporre un controllo rigido e autoritario sulla scuola.

episodes.title: Non esiste che sia amica di Kaho?!
episodes.synopsis: Renako can't bring herself to answer Ajisai's confession and ends up putting it on hold. Feeling guilty toward Mai too, she skips school. Unsure how to respond to both girls' feelings, she stays home and broods. While looking through an old album, she finds a photo of a little girl who looks just like someone in her current group...!?

episodes.title: Non esiste che riesca a fare cosplay!
episodes.synopsis: Renako reluctantly accepts Kaho's invite to a cosplay photoshoot. Renako is so nervous that the first session ends up a disaster, so Kaho launches a "Renako's Magical Modification," making her listen to a mysterious hypnosis track. Renako first thought it was silly, but it leaves her oddly hyped, and she heads into the next shoot full of confidence... with unexpected results.

episodes.title: Non esiste che abbiamo un appuntamento al parco divertimenti!
episodes.synopsis: After the photoshoot, Renako and Kaho have a girls' night at a love hotel. Swept up in Kaho's energy, Renako even ends up bathing with her! Then an unexpected invite to a major event arrives, throwing everything into chaos. Later, Renako, Mai, and Ajisai go to an amusement park - only to face an unforeseen incident...

episodes.title: Non esiste che salga su quel palco!
episodes.synopsis: The requirements for participating in the Cosplay Summit was to compete as a pair. Renako builds up the courage to accept Kaho's invitation and go. After feverishly preparing their cosplays, the summit finally comes around. But then a crisis happens, as Kaho drops her contact lens - the key to her "extrovert cosplay." And in the midst of it all, Mai and Ajisai are also starting to move...

episodes.title: Non esiste che ci mettiamo insieme... oppure sì?
episodes.synopsis: Kaho and Renako are relieved to have finally finished their Cosplay Summit performance, when they're suddenly joined not only by Satuki, but by Ajisai as well! Then Mai appears on the main stage as a special guest. As the four watch her shine, Ajisai rushes to join Mai under the bright lights, and Ajisai and Kaho urge Renako to come along. At last, Renako makes her decision...?!

info.title: Marriage of God & Soul Godannar!!
info.synopsis: Cinque anni fa, mentre combatteva contro una forza aliena conosciuta come “Mimesis”, il pilota Dannar Goh Saruwatari incontrò per la prima volta Anna Aoi. Oggi, nel giorno del loro matrimonio, la cerimonia viene interrotta quando i Mimesis attaccano di nuovo. Mentre Goh lotta contro la minaccia aliena, Anna si imbatte in un robot top secret chiamato “Neo-Okusaer” e lo usa come ultima risorsa per salvare il suo fidanzato. In quel momento, Dannar e Neo-Okusaer si fondono per diventare il potente robot “Godannar”.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Five years ago, while battling an alien force known as the "Mimesis," Dannar pilot Goh Saruwatari first met Anna Aoi. Today, on the day of their wedding, the ceremony is interrupted when the Mimesis strike again. As Goh struggles in his battle against the alien threat, Anna stumbles upon a top secret robot known as the "Neo-Okusaer" and uses it as a last-resort to save her fiance. At that moment, Dannar and Neo-Okusaer merge to become the mighty robot "Godannar.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: As Anna begins her rigerous training as a robot pilot, she and Goh also try to adjust to their first days of living together. After a silly argument which has Anna go into town to blow off some steam, the mimetec they fought last week appears, attacking Anna directly.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: When a Mimetec appears in the South China Sea, robot teams from several nations gather to battle it. Meanwhile, Anna and Goh vow to battle together through thick and thin.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Shizuru begins to question if she belongs on Dannar base any longer, especially after Goh and Anna are hurt in battle. But after encouragement from Anna, Shizuru's confidence is rejuvinated and she, Anna, and Goh defeat the latest Mimetec threat.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: When Astro Base is attacked by a Mimetec, Lou is forced to eject to Earth while her father stays to protect the base. When Lou and Goh return to the base to keep it from crashing in Earth, they end up fighting the Mimetec to avenge Lou's father.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis:
未だに、ミラを失った5年前の戦いの悪夢にうなされるゴオに、ある日霧子から衝撃的な事実を打ち明けられる。

5年前の戦いで死亡したと思われていた、戦友マックスとかつての恋人ミラが生きていたというのだ。

しかし、ミラは記憶も知識も全く失ってしまっていた。

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: The newly revived Max steals Myra away, leading to a confrontation with Goh, whom he blames for losing her in the first place.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: In the wake of Max' attack, Knight Valentine stirs up trouble, one woman at a time.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: After the fighters crash on an island, Dannar Base begins to send out rescue ships. Go, Anna, Knight, and Ellis inspect the damage to their robots. Okusaer and Dannar can move, but the jetboys are heavily damaged, so the four of them are stuck there.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis:
戦闘禁止地区において何者かによる戦闘の痕跡が見つかり、Menage-Zeroが発令された。

そこ残された多数の擬態獣の死骸が、父親を襲った擬態獣と同じであることを知ったルウは戦いに参加したいと申し出る。

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Lu is reprimanded for her actions while Goh encounters the rogue mech pilot.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: With Godannar and Neo-Okusaer out of commission, the only one to challenge a new Mimetic threat is Shizuru.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: While the base reels at the loss of one of their own, Anna continues to sort things out.

episodes.title: Steel Ball Run
episodes.synopsis: Dopo un fatidico incontro con il fuorilegge Gyro Zeppeli, l'ex prodigio delle corse Johnny Joestar partecipa alla Steel Ball Run, la prima corsa di cavalli attraverso l'America.

info.title: Onegai☆Teacher: Himitsu na Futari
info.synopsis: Kei e Mizuho stanno attraversando un periodo difficile nel loro matrimonio, e la famiglia di Mizuho decide che è giunto il momento di andare a trovarli.

episodes.title: Coppia segreta
episodes.synopsis: Hatsuho and Maho visit and force Mizuho to talk about intimate moments with Kei. Hatsuho kidnaps Kei, takes him to a love hotel, and ties him to a bed. Although Hatsuho is sexually attracted to Kei, it is actually an attempt to add excitement into Kei and Mizuho's marriage.

info.synopsis: Seconda stagione di The Elusive Samurai

episodes.title: Longing for Sea Bream!
episodes.synopsis: I membri dello shogunato tessono le loro trame e il gruppo di Tokiyuki prepara il suo piatto preferito.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: The Ashikaga forces keep a vigilant watch across the country, searching for remnants of the Hojo clan scattered throughout Japan. Sadamune, the governor of Shinano, has grown suspicious of “Chojumaru,” a young warrior who has repeatedly distinguished himself in battle—first during the dog-shooting competition, and later on the battlefield.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Provincial official Kiyohara returns to Shinano after fleeing back to Kyo following the previous battle. Having grown even more ruthless, Kiyohara launches a large-scale invasion against pro-Hojo factions in northern Shinano. To oppose the combined forces of Kiyohara and Sadamune, the three great generals of the Suwa faith—Nezu, Mochizuki, and Unno, retainers directly serving Yorishige.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Tokiyuki and his companions race across the battlefield, sparing even the slightest moments of rest in order to relay information to their allies. However, when they arrive at the northern front where Mochizuki and Tokoiwa are fighting, what they witness is a fortress engulfed in flames, falliing into ruin... Ayako collapses in grief as she thinks of her father, Shigenobu Mochizuki.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: The central battlefield descends into total chaos. Just as victory seems within reach for the Hoshina–Shinomiya forces, a new obstacle suddenly appears before them: Kiyohara’s newly devised battle mikoshi. Originally intended as a palanquin for issuing commands from the rear, it is now reinforced with heavy armor.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: The battle ends in defeat for the Suwa Sect. Although they manage to keep casualties to a minimum, the losses they suffer are significant. As they look toward the next great conflict, everyone in the Suwa Sect comes to share an even stronger resolve. The battle becomes another valuable lesson for Tokiyuki as well—one that helps him grow even further.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Tokiyuki’s uncle, Yasuie Hojo, is still alive! Once a key figure at the heart of the Kamakura Shogunate, Yasuie survives the fall of Kamakura. Afterward, he travels throughout the Tohoku region, continuing to fight alongside the remaining Hojo loyalists. But after suffering defeat after defeat, he eventually finds his way to Suwa.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: At the suggestion of Yorishige and Yasuie, Tokiyuki sets out for the capital, Kyo, together with the Elusive Warriors. Major Counselor Kinmune Saionji, an ally of Yasuie, awaits their arrival in Kyo. While Yasuie and Kinmune conduct a secret discussion, Tokiyuki and his companions venture out into the city.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Having grown closer over a game of dice, Mima invites Tokiyuki and his companions on a tour of Kyo. Even though they know she is the daughter of their enemy, the Elusive Warriors accept her kindness and spend a brief, youthful moment enjoying themselves as ordinary boys and girls. However, upon returning to the Saionji's residence, Tokiyuki and the others are informed of a plan for an uprising.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Through his dialogue with the warrior Masashige Kusunoki, known as a “god of war,” Tokiyuki is moved by Kusunoki's unwavering convictions and develops an even deeper sense of confidence in the possibilities of “fleeing.” Just as he is smiling over this fortunate encounter, everything suddenly changes when he hears news of his sworn enemy Takauji’s movements.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Although the attempt to assassinate Takauji ends in failure, Tokiyuki has grown significantly as a warrior through his experiences in Kyo. Upon his return to Suwa, Yorishige tells him that the time has finally come. The attempted assassinations of both the Emperor and Takauji plunged Kyo into chaos, where warriors from the Kanto area were summoned and the city's defenses were reinforced.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: With preparations for war complete, the Suwa forces are finally about to ignite the great conflict. Tokiyuki is appointed commander-in-chief, taking command of the “Kamakura Party,” a unit formed from surviving retainers of the Hojo clan—while keeping his true identity hidden. Can he prove himself worthy as a leader to those who feel uneasy about serving under a child?

info.title: My Hero Academia: I am a hero too (ITA)
info.synopsis: Eri, ormai studentessa delle superiori, torna a visitare la U.A. High School, il luogo che ha segnato profondamente la sua infanzia. Durante la visita, i ricordi del passato si intrecciano con le nuove sfide del presente, mentre ritrova volti familiari e scopre quanto siano cambiati gli eroi che un tempo l'hanno salvata. Adattamento dell'omonimo one-shot pubblicato nel fanbook del 2025 Boku no Hero Academia: Ultra Age.
